page.overview:
Who is Flame Lord?

In "The Red Throne," he helps Flame King overthrow Flame Princess in return for her hand in marriage. When Flame Princess refuses, however, Flame Lord feels cheated and has a fistfight with Flame King. During this fight, Cinnamon Bun frees Finn and Flame Princess from their prison and has Flame King returned to his lantern together with the Flame Lord.

Flame Lord is a wizard who wears a huge red coat that covers his body. He has long, red- and purple-striped horns on his head. He wears a mask that has a dark-purple face and yellow eyes with red slit pupils on them. He also has yellow lips and a red slit mouth. He has fire on his shoulders and hands and has a black belt with a flaming buckle and two large, muscular dark-purple legs.

In the episode "The Red Throne," he loses his sleeves and appears more muscular since his last appearance.

In the episode "The Red Throne," Flame Lord helped Flame King with overthrowing Flame Princess and taking over the Fire Kingdom. However, he felt as if he'd been cheated after that, and he got into a fist fight with Flame King. In the end, Flame Princess trapped both of them inside the lantern together and took her throne back again.
